label: Bible Study
prompt: The fear of the LORD is the _____ of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.
verse: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.
note: A close cousin of the book's motto — wisdom starts with reverence for the LORD.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the _____, the first and the last.
verse: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.
note: Jesus is the A to Z, start to finish — nothing comes before Him or after.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he _____: for he hath been dead four days.
verse: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.
note: Practical Martha objected to opening Lazarus' tomb: four days in, 'he stinketh' — the KJV doesn't sugarcoat it.

label: Deep Water
prompt: My days are swifter than a weaver's _____, and are spent without hope.
verse: My days are swifter than a weaver's shuttle, and are spent without hope.
note: A weaver's shuttle flies back and forth faster than the eye can follow — Job says his days go like that.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Then the LORD rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah _____ and fire from the LORD out of heaven;
verse: Then the LORD rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the LORD out of heaven;
note: Fire and 'brimstone' on Sodom and Gomorrah — the scene behind Jesus' shortest warning: 'Remember Lot's wife' (Luke 17:32).
